updates: Clarified current intensity formula as interval-average and stated the full definition of constant current: both direction and magnitude are constant.
Added explicit conditions for R=rho*l/S: homogeneous conductor, uniform cross-section, fixed thermal state/rho.
Clarified emf definition uses positive charge magnitude moved internally from negative to positive terminal; q=It statement limited to constant current.
Tightened conditions for P=UI, P=I^2R, P=U^2/R and Q=I^2Rt; added variable-I/R Joule form and prevented use of resistor formulas for sources/receivers.
Stated the direct full-circuit Ohm law scope: one equivalent source feeding a purely resistive external equivalent load in steady DC.
Added practical DC meter polarity/range condition without changing ideal-meter model.
Stated Kirchhoff section scope as steady DC lumped circuits and emphasized consistent sign conventions.
